services.name: Air Show on the Bay - Wind Dancer
services.desc: Book the best seat on the bay for the Cherry Festival Airshow! Price $289 About Our Airshow on the Bay sail runs July 4th and 5th, 12:00 - 4:30 p.m. Embark on an unforgettable journey aboard the majestic Wind Dancer Schooner for the National Cherry Festival Air Show on the Bay. After departure, our Crew will raise the sails and share some insights on the region until the air show starts. The Captain will strategically position the schooner for breathtaking views of the airshow. Indulge in delicious regional fare while sipping on locally curated beer, wines, and cocktails listening to live broadcast from WCCW. services.name: Cherry Festival Fireworks Finale - Guided Pontoon Charter
T.I. Guided Pontoon Charter
services.desc: About Embark on an enchanting evening boating experience on Traverse City's West Bay. Our Captain will drop anchor on the bay near the National Cherry Festival's main stage, where you can take in the full T.I. concert and the beauty of the Traverse City waterfront. Don't miss this extraordinary fusion of boating and musical brilliance, promising an unforgettable experience as we join our boating community for a night under the stars. Bring your own food and drink and have the fun you deserve on the brilliant blue water of the Grand Traverse Bay. There may be an opportunity to swim, weather and wind permitting. What to Bring You’re welcome to bring beverages, including alcohol, and food.
